scripts.text: Do you want to build connections without being in a guild?
scripts.translation: 想不加入公會也結交夥伴嗎？

scripts.text: Can't find the perfect guild for yourself?
scripts.translation: 找不到適合自己的公會嗎？

scripts.text: You can join or leave clans freely! Just join!
scripts.translation: 可以自由加入或離開氏族！快來加入吧！

scripts.text: Now, come on in and meet the masters of the Kingdom's best clans!
scripts.translation: 來認識一下王國最佳氏族的首領們吧！

scripts.text: Hi! I'm Raffam, master of the ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 你好！我是拉法姆，盧恩-米德加爾特王國^3131FF劍士氏族^000000的首領。

scripts.text: The ^3131FFClans^000000 are a type of guild ran by the Kingdom.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF氏族^000000是由王國管理的一種公會。

scripts.text: They don't participate in the Siege, so members are free to join/leave anytime.
scripts.translation: 氏族不參加攻城戰，所以成員可以隨時加入或離開。

scripts.text: I wish we could join the Siege. I'd love flying over on my dragon and burning everyone in my way!
scripts.translation: 真希望我們也能參加攻城戰。我好想騎著龍飛過去，把擋路的人全燒光！

scripts.text: Join us, if no Clan suits your taste.
scripts.translation: 如果找不到合適的氏族，就加入我們吧。

scripts.text: New members are given ^3131FFfree stat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation: 新成員可以獲得^3131FF免費能力值加成^000000。

scripts.text: Melee stats are offered as the name ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 suggests, but not all members are Melee classes.
scripts.translation: 正如^3131FF劍士氏族^000000之名，我們提供近戰能力值加成，不過成員不一定都是近戰職業。

scripts.text: Don't feel pressured, just count on me!
Differences in variety creates the fun.
These odd bunches never bore me in the party.
scripts.translation: 和這些性格各異的傢伙組隊，我從來不會覺得無聊。

scripts.text: And who knows you might meet your soul mate in the Clan? Hahah!
scripts.translation: 說不定你還能在氏族裡遇見命中註定的人呢？哈哈！

scripts.text: The ^3131FFSword Clan^000000 mainly supports Melee adventurers.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF劍士氏族^000000主要支援近戰冒險者。

scripts.text: Join for free ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000!

scripts.translation: 記住，氏族不能參加攻城戰。

scripts.text: You should contact other guilds for Siege.
scripts.translation: 想參加攻城戰的話，請聯絡其他公會。
迫不及待想加入我這邊了嗎？哈哈！

scripts.text: Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation: 那麼我們先確認氏族規定，再開始入會手續。

scripts.text: New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation: 新成員可獲得以下能力值加成：^FF0000<STR+1, VIT+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
scripts.translation: 你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果^FF0000超過兩週^000000沒有上線，就會被^FF0000逐出^000000。

scripts.text: Clan masters exist for reason, like I.
scripts.translation: 氏族首領自有其存在的意義，就像我一樣。

scripts.text: Great, sign your name here to register.
scripts.translation: 很好，請在這裡簽名登記。

scripts.text: Come back to join after you leave your current guild.
scripts.translation: 退出當前公會後再回來加入吧。

scripts.text: Eh? Oh, you're in a Clan.
scripts.translation: 咦？哦，你已經加入氏族了。

scripts.text: Don't mess with me, it's not cool!
You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
Uh, oh. Let's go back to the beginning.
No problem. I hope you'll find a more suitable Clan.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。希望你能找到更適合自己的氏族。

scripts.text: Wait, you're not with us! Grr, don't make me breathe fire at you!
scripts.translation: 等等，你不是我們的人！哼，別逼我對你噴火！

scripts.text: Hey, talk to your guild master if you want to leave.
scripts.translation: 喂，想退出的話去找你的公會會長。

scripts.text: Okay, it's done. But let's not be strangers, okay?
scripts.translation: 好了，手續辦完了。不過以後還是朋友，好嗎？

scripts.text: I'm Devon, master of the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation: 我是德文，^3131FF奧術手杖氏族^000000的首領。

scripts.text: The ^3131FFClans^000000 are ran by the Kingdom, not privately like others.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF氏族^000000由王國管理，不像其他公會那樣由私人經營。

scripts.text: And I manage one of them.
scripts.translation: 我負責管理其中一個氏族。

scripts.text: What's with that look? You got a problem?
scripts.translation: 你那是什麼表情？有意見嗎？

scripts.text: Brother, you're scaring a potential member, be nice.
scripts.translation: 哥哥，你嚇到未來的成員了，客氣點。

scripts.text: Join if you are seeking a place to fit in. We give ^3131FFfree bonus stats^000000. But no Siege participation.
scripts.translation: 想找個歸屬的話就加入吧。我們提供^3131FF免費能力值加成^000000，不能參加攻城戰。

scripts.text: Most members are offensive Mage classes as the name ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 suggests, but that's no requirement.
scripts.translation: 正如^3131FF奧術手杖氏族^000000之名，大多數成員都是攻擊型魔法師，但這不是加入條件。

scripts.text: Stop hitting on my brother and get to work.
scripts.translation: 別再撩我哥哥了，快乾活。

scripts.text: Listen, Crossbow Clan's master is evil.
scripts.translation: 聽著，弩弓氏族的首領是個壞人。

scripts.text: Get over me, Devon! Don't spread rumors!
scripts.translation: 德文，別再糾纏我了！別散播謠言！

scripts.text: Haha. Stop it. You two are making a scene.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，別鬧了。你們兩個都引人圍觀了。

scripts.text: Come on, back to work guys.
The ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000 mainly supports offensive Mage classes.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF奧術手杖氏族^000000主要支援攻擊型魔法師。

scripts.text: We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members. Don't ask for more; it's the Kingdom's rule.
scripts.translation: 新成員可獲得^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。別要求更多，這是王國的規定。

scripts.text: If you like the Siege, then go join a regular guild.
scripts.translation: 喜歡攻城戰的話，就加入普通公會吧。

scripts.text: Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation: 那麼我們先確認氏族規定，再開始入會手續。

scripts.text: New members are given these stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation: 新成員可獲得以下能力值加成：^FF0000<INT+1, DEX+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
scripts.translation: 你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果^FF0000超過兩週^000000沒有上線，就會被^FF0000逐出^000000。

scripts.text: Good, let me invite you in.
Leave your guild first to join my Clan, duh.
scripts.translation: 先退出公會才能加入我的氏族，這還用說嗎。

scripts.text: You're already in a Clan. You joking?!
scripts.translation: 你已經加入氏族了。你在開玩笑嗎？！

scripts.text: Oh, I can be funny, too--FIRE PILLAR!
scripts.translation: 哦，我也會開玩笑——火柱攻擊！

scripts.text: You have joined the ^3131FFArc Wand Clan^000000.
scripts.translation: 你已加入^3131FF奧術手杖氏族^000000。

scripts.text: You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
That's all. Visit often or be expelled. Dismissed.
scripts.translation: 就這樣。多來露面，否則就會被逐出。解散。

scripts.text: Gosh, listen to the policy again.
I understand, it's about Sieges. If not, why are..Never mind..
scripts.translation: 我明白，你是為了攻城戰。要不是這個原因，又怎麼會...算了...
我來處理你的退出手續。

scripts.text: Naughty children deserve a good Jupitel Thunder.
scripts.translation: 不聽話的孩子就該嚐嚐雷鳴術的滋味。

scripts.text: You're barking up the wrong tree. Go to your Clan master.
scripts.translation: 你找錯人了。去找你的氏族首領吧。

scripts.text: You are withdrawn from the Clan.
Now leave. I don't feel like talking anymore.
scripts.translation: 現在走吧。我不想再說話了。

scripts.text: Nice to meet you. I'm Berman Aire, master of the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
scripts.translation: 幸會。我是伯曼·艾爾，^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000的首領。

scripts.text: I'm also the older brother of Devon Aire. Devon looks tough, but he's kind hearted.
scripts.translation: 我也是德文·艾爾的哥哥。德文看起來嚴厲，其實心地善良。

scripts.text: The ^3131FFClans^000000 are established by the Kingdom to help adventurers connect and share information.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF氏族^000000由王國建立，旨在幫助冒險者結識彼此、分享情報。

scripts.text: Because the Kingdom runs the Clan, there is no Siege participation, but at least the members are given ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation: 由於氏族由王國管理，不能參加攻城戰；不過成員至少可以獲得^3131FF能力值加成^000000。

scripts.text: The stat bonuses are small, but can be very useful for beginning adventurers.
scripts.translation: 能力值加成雖然不多，對新手冒險者卻很有幫助。

scripts.text: We're named the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000, but we don't discriminate against applicants based on their classes.
scripts.translation: 我們叫作^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000，但不會因職業不同而拒絕申請者。

scripts.text: The name is just to help you easily choose your Clan.
scripts.translation: 名稱只是為了方便你選擇氏族。

scripts.text: Berman, enough with the explanation. Let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 伯曼，解釋夠多了。我們去古城逛逛吧。

scripts.text: Berman, call me when you can!~
Hah hah, I apologize for their bickering.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，抱歉他們總是吵架。

scripts.text: If you're tired of traveling alone, join us! You can join and leave the Clan anytime you want.
scripts.translation: 如果厭倦了獨自旅行，就加入我們吧！你可以隨時加入或離開氏族。

scripts.text: The ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000 mainly helps supportive classes.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000主要幫助輔助型職業。

scripts.text: We offer ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000 to new members.
scripts.translation: 新成員可獲得^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: As I told you earlier, Clans cannot join the Siege because they already belong to the Kingdom.
scripts.translation: 正如我之前所說，氏族隸屬於王國，因此不能參加攻城戰。

scripts.text: If you want to be in the Siege, then I recommend you join a regular guild.
scripts.translation: 如果你想參加攻城戰，我建議你加入普通公會。

scripts.text: Do you understand what the Clans are about now?
scripts.translation: 現在明白氏族是什麼了嗎？

scripts.text: Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation: 那麼我們先確認氏族規定，再開始入會手續。

scripts.text: As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation: 作為新成員，你將獲得以下能力值加成：^FF0000<INT+1, LUK+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
scripts.translation: 你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果^FF0000超過兩週^000000沒有上線，就會被^FF0000逐出^000000。

scripts.text: Do you agree to maintain good standing in the Clan?
scripts.translation: 你願意遵守氏族規定嗎？

scripts.text: Now, please write your name here.
scripts.translation: 現在，請在這裡寫下你的名字。

scripts.text: In order to join, you first have to leave your current guild.
scripts.translation: 想加入的話，先退出當前公會。
歡迎加入^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000！

scripts.text: You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
Please remember the few precautions I gave you, and enjoy your Clan activities!
scripts.translation: 記住我剛才提醒的事項，祝你享受氏族生活！

scripts.text: I hope you enjoyed your time in the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000.
scripts.translation: 希望你在^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000過得愉快。

scripts.text: Now, should I process your withdrawal?
scripts.translation: 那麼，我現在為你辦理退出手續嗎？

scripts.text: You can't leave the Clan without joining it first.
scripts.translation: 你還沒加入氏族，不能退出。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I can't remove you from another Clan...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能替你退出其他氏族...

scripts.text: Come back anytime to the ^3131FFGolden Mace Clan^000000. I'll be here.
scripts.translation: 隨時歡迎回到^3131FF黃金釘錘氏族^000000，我會一直在這裡。

scripts.text: Hi, there! I'm Shaam, master of the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000
scripts.translation: 你好！我是莎姆，^3131FF弩弓氏族^000000的首領。

scripts.text: What can I do for you?
The Clans were established by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to...
scripts.translation: 盧恩-米德加爾特王國建立氏族，是為了...
拉法姆，我們的^3131FF氏族^000000是做什麼用的？

scripts.text: Did you sleep in class? Gosh.
scripts.translation: 你上課睡覺了嗎？真是的。

scripts.text: The Clans help lone adventurers connect with each other and share information.
scripts.translation: 氏族幫助獨行冒險者互相結識、分享情報。

scripts.text: A-ha, got it! Thank you, Captain!
scripts.translation: 啊哈，明白了！謝謝你，隊長！

scripts.text: Run by the Kingdom itself, the Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege, but the good news is that the members are given some ^3131FFstat bonuses^000000.
scripts.translation: 氏族由王國直接管理，不能參加攻城戰；好訊息是成員可以獲得一些^3131FF能力值加成^000000。

scripts.text: In case you wonder if the ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 only recruits Archers, no, it doesn't.
scripts.translation: 如果你在想^3131FF弩弓氏族^000000是不是隻招募弓箭手，答案是否定的。

scripts.text: All the Clans accept all classes. You can choose the one that suits your needs best.
scripts.translation: 所有氏族都接納各種職業。你可以選擇最適合自己的氏族。

scripts.text: That should cover everything there is to know.
scripts.translation: 該說明的應該都說完了。

scripts.text: Berman, let's go hang out in Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 伯曼，我們去古城逛逛吧。

scripts.text: Ooh, scary! You're so protective of your brother.
scripts.translation: 哦，好可怕！你這麼護著哥哥啊。

scripts.text: The ^3131FFCrossbow Clan^000000 is ideal for ranged classes.
Eh, let me check the Clan manual. Ah, and we offer stat bonuses to new members: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我查查氏族手冊。哦，新成員可獲得能力值加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: The Clans are not allowed to participate in the Siege; you should join a private guild instead for Siege.
scripts.translation: 氏族不能參加攻城戰；想參戰的話，應該加入普通公會。

scripts.text: The Clans are for adventurers that hate being tied down.
scripts.translation: 氏族適合不喜歡受束縛的冒險者。

scripts.text: Let's check the Clan policy then to begin admission procedures.
scripts.translation: 那麼我們先確認氏族規定，再開始入會手續。

scripts.text: As our new member, you'll receive the following stat bonuses: ^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000.
scripts.translation: 作為新成員，你將獲得以下能力值加成：^FF0000<DEX+1, AGI+1, MHP+30, MSP+10>^000000。

scripts.text: You can join and leave a Clan anytime, but if you don't login for ^FF0000more than 2 weeks^000000, you'll be ^FF0000expelled^000000.
scripts.translation: 你可以隨時加入或離開氏族，但如果^FF0000超過兩週^000000沒有上線，就會被^FF0000逐出^000000。

scripts.text: Do you promise you'll maintain good standing?
scripts.translation: 你保證會遵守氏族規定嗎？
很好，在這裡寫下你的名字。

scripts.text: Ugh, your penmanship needs work. Let me process your application.
scripts.translation: 唉，你的字寫得真差。讓我來處理你的申請。

scripts.text: Did you finish things up with your guild?
scripts.translation: 你已經處理好原公會的事了嗎？

scripts.text: Eh, you're already in a Clan. Hey, this isn't funny.
scripts.translation: 咦，你已經加入氏族了。喂，這可不好笑。

scripts.text: You can review Clan info with ^3131FFCtrl+G^000000.
Don't pick fights with other clansmen. Be social.
scripts.translation: 別和其他氏族成員打架，要友善相處。

scripts.text: If you need help, you can always whisper me, okay? See you around!
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙的話，隨時密語找我，好嗎？回頭見！

scripts.text: All right then. I'm just going to go have some fun.
Ah, do you need time to think about this? No problem.
scripts.translation: 啊，你需要時間考慮嗎？沒問題。

scripts.text: Why, did you find a better Clan?
scripts.translation: 怎麼，找到更好的氏族了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm disappointed, but it's your call. Let me process your withdrawal.
scripts.translation: 我有點失望，不過由你決定。我來辦理退出手續。

scripts.text: I can't let you leave--you're not even in my Clan!
scripts.translation: 我不能讓你退出——你根本不是我氏族的成員！

scripts.text: Sorry, but I don't meddle with other Clans' business.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不插手其他氏族的事。

scripts.text: If you ever miss us, don't hesitate to come back, alright?
scripts.translation: 如果哪天想念我們，隨時回來，好嗎？
